title: The six roots
lead: Six classic drinks are the patterns most cocktails follow. Learn them and every new drink is a variation.

sections.name: The Old Fashioned
know: Spirit sweetened and seasoned: spirit, sugar and bitters.
Stirred over ice, served on a big cube.

sections.name: The Martini

lines.label: In short
lines.text: A spirit and vermouth, stirred cold.

know: Spirit plus vermouth: gin or vodka with dry vermouth.
Stirred and strained up, very cold.
Manhattan is the same idea: whiskey and sweet vermouth.

sections.name: The Daiquiri

lines.label: In short
lines.text: Spirit, citrus and sugar: the sour.

know: Sour pattern: spirit, citrus and sugar.
Same Pattern as the Whiskey Sour, Gimlet and Pisco Sour.

sections.name: The Sidecar

lines.label: In short
lines.text: A sour sweetened with a liqueur.

know: Liqueur sweetens it: spirit, citrus and orange liqueur.
Margarita and Cosmopolitan follow the same pattern.

sections.name: The Highball

lines.label: In short
lines.text: A spirit made long with something bubbly.

know: Spirit made long with something bubbly.
Built in a tall glass over ice.
Same Pattern as the Moscow Mule, Dark ’n’ Stormy and Paloma.

sections.name: The Flip

lines.label: In short
lines.text: Egg or cream for a rich drink.

know: Rich drinks: egg or cream give the body.
Shaken hard to mix and foam.
Brandy Alexander gets its body from cream.

video.title: How I Make an Old Fashioned
How I Make an Old Fashioned

keyPoints.line: sweetened and seasoned: spirit, sugar and bitters.
over ice, served on a big cube.

read.where: The **Old Fashioned** is a spirit with a little **sugar** and **bitters**, stirred and served over ice. It’s all spirit, so it’s **stirred**, not shaken. The **Sazerac** follows the same pattern.

keyPoints.line: plus vermouth: gin or vodka with dry vermouth.
is the same idea: whiskey and sweet vermouth.

read.bigIdea: A spirit and vermouth, stirred cold.
read.where: The **Martini** pairs a spirit with **vermouth**, stirred and strained **up**. Swap the gin for whiskey and the dry vermouth for sweet, and you have a **Manhattan**.

keyPoints.line: as the Whiskey Sour, Gimlet and Pisco Sour.

read.bigIdea: Spirit, citrus and sugar: the sour.
read.where: The **Daiquiri** is rum, **lime** and **sugar**, shaken and served up. Swap the spirit and the citrus and you get the **Whiskey Sour**, the **Gimlet** and the **Pisco Sour**.

keyPoints.line: sweetens it: spirit, citrus and orange liqueur.
and Cosmopolitan follow the same pattern.

read.bigIdea: A sour sweetened with a liqueur.
read.where: The **Sidecar** is brandy, **lemon** and an **orange liqueur**, shaken and served up. The liqueur does the sweetening. The **Margarita** and the **Cosmopolitan** follow the same pattern.

video.title: How to Make the Dark ’N Stormy

keyPoints.line: in a tall glass over ice.
as the Moscow Mule, Dark ’n’ Stormy and Paloma.

read.bigIdea: A spirit made long with something bubbly.
read.where: A **highball** is a spirit and a **bubbly mixer**, built in a **tall glass** over ice. The **Moscow Mule**, the **Dark ’n’ Stormy** and the **Paloma** all follow this pattern.

keyPoints.line: drinks: egg or cream give the body.

read.bigIdea: Egg or cream for a rich drink.
read.where: A **flip** gets its richness from **egg**, **cream** or both. It’s **shaken hard** so it mixes and gets a light foam. The **Brandy Alexander** gets its body from cream the same way.
